previous_goal_turn: Progress: canonical queue-clock prediction and live-mode cleanup were implemented and verified with 155 tests. The interpreter and C API removal milestones remain completed.
scope: Preserve existing fallback command execution, recurrence handoff and error handling in the fixed production migration.
implementation: Retain fallback capture queues when a full timeline is installed. Release pending commands through the canonical queue clock instead of actor-rate tween timing, retaining predicted timestamps and render advancement across hibernation. Start a new recurring command with only its saved dispatch remainder and prevent double consumption in the same frame. Report runtime queue errors once while preserving partial writes and continued traversal. Scope absent timestamps independently from enclosing queued dispatch; restore scopes after callbacks and errors. Queue overflow accounting uses the canonical pending steps.
coverage_changes: Four native/Rust comparisons cover faster/slower actors, hibernation wake at zero delta, backdated publication and advancement, recurring renewal/conditional stopping/errors, queue errors across Stop, GC and nested inline commands with an absent timestamp. The original three failing cases and all 52 prior activation tests are preserved.

development_runs.note: Reproduced early rate-dependent dispatch and escaping recurring/queue errors before implementation.
All initial failures passed after replacing fallback execution. Added the nested absent-timestamp case and its scope override for final verification.

limits: These comparisons establish command timing and the supported immediate/render property buffers. Complete fallback pose sampling/getter reconciliation and remaining pose/text/media output still need integration, as do startup/retained session orchestration and full compiler/live consumers. Streamed replay without a canonical timeline retains its existing path. Fatal resource/execution errors retain the adapter propagation policy; this was not an exhaustive exhaustion campaign.
remaining: Complete pose and remaining output capture, full compiler/live/session orchestration and fallback/cache, tracked/wrapper remapping, unconditional production cutover, then the original fixture/application/render/dependency/link/performance gates.
timing_note: Recorded durations include compilation and are verification costs, not application performance measurements.
